summary.text: Pregnancy Temple is a human path Immortal Gu House Fang Yuan builds in numbers across the sovereign immortal aperture so mortals can rapidly have children, sometimes born with Gu worms.

claims.text: In Mini Western Desert, an inkman couple’s newborn arrives with a pair of bone flesh unity Gu. The female doctor asks whether this is the effect of the Pregnancy Temple. The father says that after the Pregnancy Temple was built, he and his wife tried it, and it worked. The doctor says the temple can help people rapidly have children, and if lucky the children are born with Gu worms. Fang Yuan’s divine sense observes and leaves. This Pregnancy Temple is his arrangement. There are many such mortal Gu Houses; after he builds them, he places them all over the sovereign immortal aperture for the people to use.
Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Pregnancy Temple is a named Immortal Gu House network. It is aperture infrastructure, not a five-region map seat.

Pregnancy Temple is a human path Immortal Gu House. The core human path Gu worms it uses include become pregnant Gu, triplet Gu, dead fetus Gu, multiple pregnancy Gu, and safe pregnancy Gu. It also uses a large number of time path and refinement path Gu worms. It extracts the yin-yang qi of the male and female to activate become pregnant Gu and make the female pregnant, then uses triplet Gu to turn the fetus into triplets. Two fetuses become Gu materials after dead fetus Gu activates, while safe pregnancy Gu protects the final one. The two dead fetuses are refined as bone flesh unity Gu, born together with the final fetus. Time path Gu worms keep the whole pregnancy to childbirth within seven days, so the aperture population can rise rapidly.
